assessment.diversity_evidence: The set repeatedly uses the same pottery-gift setup and shaping mishap. Most stories turn the dent into a thumb rest (for example, s000014 and s000048); another branch smooths it and ends with Grandpa holding the wide handle (s000028 and s000041); a smaller branch reshapes the cup into a bowl (s000034 and s000039). These are few closely related variants, not evidence about the entire generator.
